lessons.title: A balanced opinion
lessons.summary: Выражай мнение уверенно и добавляй нюансы.

exercises.title: Связывай идеи
exercises.explanation: Используй however для контраста, therefore для результата и although для уступки.

exercises.prompt: From my perspective…
exercises.example: From my perspective, flexible hours improve productivity.

exercises.prompt: Her decision was quick and sensible.
exercises.translation: Её решение было быстрым и разумным.
exercises.example: Her decision was quick and sensible, and nobody argued.

exercises.prompt: С моей точки зрения, это разумное решение.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: From my perspective, this is a sensible decision.
acceptedAnswers: In my view, this is a sensible decision.

exercises.prompt: Однако у этого подхода есть недостатки.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: However, this approach has drawbacks.

exercises.prompt: The plan is expensive. ___, it may save time later.
That being said…
exercises.example: The role is demanding. That being said, it is rewarding.

exercises.prompt: I do not entirely understand this point, but I agree.
exercises.translation: Я не совсем понимаю этот пункт, но согласен.
exercises.example: I do not entirely understand this point, but I agree with the rest.

exercises.prompt: Хотя я понимаю твою точку зрения, я не совсем согласен.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: Although I understand your point, I do not entirely agree.
acceptedAnswers: Although I understand your point, I don't entirely agree.

exercises.prompt: В результате команда закончила раньше.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: As a result, the team finished earlier.

exercises.prompt: ___ the risks, the idea is worth testing.
Every system has an advantage and a main flaw.
exercises.translation: У любой системы есть плюс и главный изъян.
exercises.example: Every system has an advantage and a main flaw; this one is no exception.

exercises.prompt: Главное преимущество заключается в том, что система проста.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: The main advantage is that the system is simple.
acceptedAnswers: The key advantage is that the system is simple.

chapters.title: Hypotheticals and the Passive
chapters.subtitle: Второй и третий условный тип и страдательный залог

lessons.title: If Only... Conditionals
lessons.summary: Учимся говорить о нереальных ситуациях во втором и третьем условном типе.

exercises.title: Second Conditional
exercises.explanation: Второй тип условия (нереальное настоящее или будущее): If + Past Simple, ... would + инфинитив. Описывает воображаемые, маловероятные ситуации. С глаголом to be часто используют were для всех лиц: if I were you.

exercises.prompt: If I were you
exercises.translation: На твоём месте (если бы я был тобой)
exercises.example: If I were you, I would apologize to her.

exercises.prompt: If I ___ you, I would take the job.
exercises.explanation: Во втором условном с to be используется were для всех лиц.

exercises.prompt: Если бы у меня было больше денег, я бы купил новую машину.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: If I had more money, I would buy a new car.
acceptedAnswers: If I had more money, I'd buy a new car.
If I had more money, I would get a new car.

exercises.prompt: Я бы позвонил тебе, если бы мог.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: I would call you if I could.

exercises.title: Third Conditional
exercises.explanation: Третий тип условия (нереальное прошлое): If + Past Perfect, ... would have + причастие (V3). Описывает то, что не случилось в прошлом, и его воображаемый результат.

exercises.prompt: I would have helped
exercises.example: I would have helped if you had asked me.

exercises.prompt: If she had studied harder, she ___ the exam.
exercises.explanation: Третий условный: would have + причастие для нереального прошлого.

exercises.prompt: Nobody told me about it.
exercises.translation: Мне никто об этом не сказал.
exercises.example: Nobody told me about it until yesterday.

exercises.prompt: Если бы ты мне сказал, я бы помог.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: If you had told me, I would have helped.
acceptedAnswers: If you had told me, I'd have helped.
If you had told me, I would have helped you.
exercises.hint: If + Past Perfect, ... would have + V3

exercises.prompt: Она бы выиграла гонку.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: She would have won the race.

lessons.title: Getting Things Done: The Passive
lessons.summary: Строим предложения в страдательном залоге, когда важно действие, а не деятель.

exercises.title: The Passive Voice
exercises.explanation: Страдательный залог: be (в нужном времени) + причастие прошедшего времени (V3). Используется, когда действующее лицо неизвестно, неважно или очевидно: The house was built in 1990.

exercises.prompt: is made of
exercises.example: This table is made of solid oak.

exercises.prompt: The house ___ in 1990.
exercises.explanation: Страдательный залог в прошедшем: was/were + V3.

exercises.prompt: Not a word was spoken.
exercises.example: The room was quiet: not a word was spoken.

exercises.prompt: Здесь говорят по-английски.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: English is spoken here.
acceptedAnswers: English is spoken here
They speak English here.

exercises.prompt: Письмо отправили вчера.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: The letter was sent yesterday.

exercises.prompt: was built
exercises.example: The bridge was built a hundred years ago.

exercises.prompt: This song ___ by millions of people.
exercises.explanation: Страдательный залог в настоящем: is/are + V3.

exercises.prompt: The author is famous, and the book is well written.
exercises.translation: Автор известен, и книга хорошо написана.
exercises.example: The author is famous, and the book is well written from the first page.

exercises.prompt: Эта книга была написана известным автором.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: This book was written by a famous author.
acceptedAnswers: The book was written by a famous author.
This book was written by a well-known author.

exercises.prompt: can be done
exercises.example: This can be done in a few minutes.

exercises.prompt: Работа уже сделана.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: The work has already been done.
acceptedAnswers: The work's already been done.
The job has already been done.

chapters.title: Reporting and Nuance
chapters.subtitle: Косвенная речь, конструкция I wish / if only, устойчивые словосочетания и фразовые глаголы

lessons.title: Reporting What People Say
lessons.summary: Косвенная речь: сдвиг времён, косвенные вопросы и полезные фразовые глаголы для пересказа.

exercises.title: Reported speech: сдвиг времён
exercises.explanation: В косвенной речи глагол обычно «сдвигается» на одно время назад: Present Simple → Past Simple, will → would. Например: "I am tired" → He said (that) he was tired.

exercises.prompt: to point out
exercises.example: She pointed out that we were running late.

exercises.prompt: She told me that she ___ call me back later.
exercises.explanation: В косвенной речи will сдвигается в would.

exercises.prompt: Он сказал, что устал.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: He said he was tired.
acceptedAnswers: He said that he was tired.
He told me he was tired.

exercises.prompt: Она сказала, что устала.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: She said she was tired.

exercises.prompt: to bring up
exercises.example: He brought up an interesting point during the meeting.

exercises.prompt: He asked me ___ I was feeling okay.
exercises.explanation: Косвенный общий вопрос вводится через if или whether.

exercises.prompt: Она спросила, во сколько начинается фильм.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: She asked what time the film started.
acceptedAnswers: She asked what time the movie started.
She asked when the film started.
exercises.hint: косвенный вопрос: прямой порядок слов, без did

exercises.prompt: Он спросил, где я живу.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: He asked where I lived.

exercises.prompt: to figure out
exercises.example: I couldn't figure out what she really meant.

lessons.title: Wishes and Nuance
lessons.summary: Конструкция I wish / if only для сожалений и полезные устойчивые словосочетания.

exercises.title: I wish / if only
exercises.explanation: Для сожаления о настоящем используем I wish / if only + Past Simple: "I wish I had more time". О прошлом — Past Perfect: "I wish I hadn't said that".

exercises.prompt: to make a decision
exercises.example: We had to make a decision quickly.

exercises.prompt: He spoke Spanish at home.
exercises.example: He spoke Spanish at home and English at work.

exercises.prompt: Жаль, что я не говорю по-испански.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: I wish I spoke Spanish.
acceptedAnswers: If only I spoke Spanish.
I wish I could speak Spanish.
exercises.hint: I wish + Past Simple для настоящего

exercises.prompt: I wish I ___ taller.
exercises.explanation: После I wish о настоящем используется was/were (в правильной речи — were).

exercises.title: Collocations
exercises.explanation: Многие слова в английском ходят «парами» (collocations): make a decision, take into account, come up with. Их лучше запоминать целиком, а не по словам.

exercises.prompt: to take something into account
exercises.example: You should take the weather into account before you leave.

exercises.prompt: Жаль, что я это сказал.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: I wish I hadn't said that.
acceptedAnswers: I wish I had not said that.
If only I hadn't said that.
exercises.hint: сожаление о прошлом: I wish + Past Perfect

exercises.prompt: We need to ___ a solution to this problem soon.
exercises.explanation: come up with — придумать, найти решение.

exercises.prompt: Жаль, что у меня мало времени.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: I wish I had more time.

exercises.prompt: to come across
exercises.example: I came across an old photo while cleaning my room.

chapters.title: Looking Ahead
chapters.subtitle: Future Continuous, Future Perfect и модальные для предположений

lessons.title: This time tomorrow
lessons.summary: Что будет идти в определённый момент и что успеет завершиться к сроку.

exercises.title: Future Continuous
exercises.explanation: Действие будет идти в конкретный момент будущего: will be плюс глагол с -ing. This time tomorrow I will be flying to Rome. Часто отвечает на вопрос «что ты будешь делать в такой-то час».

exercises.prompt: This time tomorrow I will be flying to Rome.
exercises.translation: Завтра в это время я буду лететь в Рим.
exercises.example: Don't call me at ten, this time tomorrow I will be flying to Rome.

exercises.prompt: В восемь я буду ужинать.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: At eight I will be having dinner.
acceptedAnswers: At eight I'll be having dinner.

exercises.prompt: Don't call at six, we ___ .
Она будет ждать нас в аэропорту.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: She will be waiting for us at the airport.

exercises.title: Future Perfect
exercises.explanation: Действие завершится к определённому моменту: will have плюс третья форма. By Friday I will have finished the report. Рядом обычно стоит by плюс срок.

exercises.prompt: By Friday I will have finished the report.
exercises.example: By Friday I will have finished the report and sent it.

exercises.prompt: See you next week.
exercises.example: Nothing urgent — see you next week.

exercises.prompt: К следующему году они построят мост.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: By next year they will have built the bridge.

exercises.prompt: By the time you arrive, we ___ everything.
In August she ___ here for ten years.
К понедельнику я прочитаю эту книгу.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: By Monday I will have read this book.

exercises.prompt: We will be working late tonight.
exercises.translation: Сегодня вечером мы будем работать допоздна.
exercises.example: We will be working late tonight, so let's meet tomorrow.

exercises.prompt: They are sitting in the garden.
exercises.example: They are sitting in the garden with the neighbours.

exercises.prompt: Завтра в это время мы будем сидеть на пляже.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: This time tomorrow we will be sitting on the beach.
acceptedAnswers: This time tomorrow we'll be sitting on the beach.

lessons.title: It must be true
lessons.summary: Высказываем уверенность и сомнение о настоящем и о прошлом.

exercises.title: Модальные для предположений
exercises.explanation: Уверенность, что это так: must be. Уверенность, что не так: can't be. Возможность: might be, may be, could be. Про прошлое добавляем have плюс третью форму: must have left, can't have known, might have forgotten.

exercises.prompt: He must be tired after the flight.
exercises.example: He must be tired after the flight, let him sleep.

exercises.prompt: The light is on, so she ___ at home.
He ___ my message, he never replied.
She isn't answering. She ___ busy.
Должно быть, он забыл.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: He must have forgotten.

exercises.prompt: Не может быть, чтобы она это сказала.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: She can't have said that.
acceptedAnswers: She cannot have said that.

exercises.prompt: Они, возможно, уже уехали.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: They might have already left.

chapters.title: Getting It Done
chapters.subtitle: Пассив в сложных временах, каузатив, причастные обороты и устойчивые сочетания

lessons.title: It has been done
lessons.summary: Страдательный залог за пределами простых времён и конструкция «сделать что-то чужими руками».

exercises.title: Пассив в сложных временах
exercises.explanation: Схема та же — be плюс третья форма, меняется только be. Перфект: has been done. Длительное: is being done. С модальным: must be done, can be repaired. Прошедший перфект: had been done.

exercises.prompt: The report has been sent.
exercises.example: The report has been sent to all the managers.

exercises.prompt: The road ___ at the moment.
This form ___ before Friday.
Письмо уже было отправлено.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: The letter had already been sent.

exercises.prompt: Дом сейчас красят.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: The house is being painted now.

exercises.title: Каузативные конструкции
exercises.explanation: Когда работу делает не он сам, а кто-то для него: have something done. I had my car repaired — машину чинил мастер. Get something done звучит разговорнее: I got my hair cut.

exercises.prompt: I had my car repaired last week.
exercises.translation: На прошлой неделе мне починили машину.
exercises.example: I had my car repaired last week and it runs well now.

exercises.prompt: Я подстригся вчера.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: I had my hair cut yesterday.
acceptedAnswers: I got my hair cut yesterday.

exercises.prompt: We are going to ___ the kitchen painted.
She ___ her passport stolen at the station.
The results ___ by the end of the month.

lessons.title: Saying it in fewer words
lessons.summary: Причастные обороты вместо придаточных и устойчивые сочетания.

exercises.title: Причастные обороты
exercises.explanation: Придаточное можно сжать до причастия. Активное — форма с -ing: Feeling tired, he went to bed. Пассивное — третья форма: Built in 1900, the house still stands. Подлежащее у обеих частей должно быть одно и то же.

exercises.prompt: Feeling tired, he went to bed early.
exercises.translation: Почувствовав усталость, он рано лёг спать.
exercises.example: Feeling tired, he went to bed early without dinner.

exercises.prompt: ___ in 1900, the house still looks new.
___ the door, she noticed a letter.
I wrote the address down without knowing why.
exercises.translation: Я записал адрес, сам не зная зачем.
exercises.example: I wrote the address down without knowing why I would need it.

exercises.prompt: Не зная адреса, я позвонил ей.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: Not knowing the address, I called her.

exercises.prompt: We had to take everything into account.
exercises.example: We had to take everything into account before the decision.

exercises.prompt: It's time to ___ a decision.
Who ___ up with this idea?
Если бы я знал раньше, я бы помог.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: If I had known earlier, I would have helped.

exercises.prompt: Если бы мы вышли раньше, мы бы не опоздали.
exercises.canonicalAnswer: If we had left earlier, we would not have been late.
